faqs.a:
(a)
License required.
It is unlawful for any person or entity to operate a common consumption area without
               a license. Common consumption areas must be in compliance with all applicable state
               and local laws.
(b)
Additional conditions.
The authority may place conditions on a licensee to ensure that the premises will
               be operated lawfully, to ensure that the common consumption area will be a good neighbor,
               or to add any operational requirements and restrictions included in any evidence of
               community support submitted with the application.
(
Ord. No. 4804
, § 1, 6-6-2022)
